title: When appetite calls itself seeking
subtitle: For spiritual hunger that is actually consumption
description: These readings separate holy seeking from the appetite that wants another insight, another experience, another thing to own.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Greed can borrow religious language; honorable speech tells the truth about the hunger underneath.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Ask whether your search is making you obedient or just more entertained.

evidence.coreClaim: This path unmasks the consumer impulse hiding inside spiritual seeking.
evidence.turn: Seeking becomes clean when it stops feeding novelty and starts obeying truth.
evidence.practicalImplication: Keep one teaching you already have before looking for another.
